question: How much will Crude Oil Futures total price returns exceed S&P 500 Futures in these biweekly periods of Q4 2026? (Nov 9 - Nov 20)

calls.reasoning: The window runs from the Nov 6 close to the Nov 20 close. Oil is in a Hormuz-closure/Iran supply-shock regime: WTI ~$90, down 13% this week on hopes of a deal after the midterms, while the blockade and Hormuz closure persist. The S&P 500 is also very volatile (-4.4% on Thursday). Peace news pushes oil down and stocks up, so the spread swings widely in both directions. The median sits slightly below zero because CL=F may roll from the Dec to the Jan contract around Nov 19-20, which would drag the oil return down if the curve is in backwardation. No matching human market was found on Polymarket, Manifold or Kalshi; Kalshi WTI price-level contracts exist but do not match this spread. Each tail beyond ±25pp is priced at about 5%, given that weekly oil moves of 13% are already occurring.
